d.title: Sousou no Frieren: ●● no Mahou
d.en: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Mini Anime
d.jp: 葬送のフリーレン ～●●の魔法～
syn: Sousou no Frieren: Marumaru no Mahou
d.synopsis: Frieren loves collecting peculiar spells, and her ever-growing arsenal of magic contains the perfect spells for many occasions. Whether it be by stealthily removing alcohol from Heiter's drinks or by remedying her own sleep issues, Frieren is sure to brighten her companions' days with her magic.
